technical_and_design_decisions: Leverage Spring Integration and Spring Data components for standard JDBC, Redis, and Kafka connectors.
Implement ZooKeeper ACLs and authentication options (SASL/Digest or Kerberos) at the curator client layer for zNode security.
Refactor the existing core Trigger interface and registry to allow pluggable custom trigger implementations.
Upgrade Spring Boot dependency in the build setup to 1.1.7-BUILD-SNAPSHOT to enable embedded Tomcat HTTPS/SSL configuration.
Resolve the Grunt/Protractor E2E test issue by isolating server startup/teardown timing or decoupling grunt process execution in test tasks.
assumptions: A single full-stack Java developer with familiarity in Spring XD and Spring Boot ecosystem will carry out all work.
Testing environments for external middleware (ZooKeeper, Redis, Kafka, relational databases) are available for local and integration testing.
The scope of U5 is limited to developing a reference custom module example and accompanying developer guide.
Spring Boot 1.1.7-BUILD-SNAPSHOT repository access is configured and stable in the build script.

activities.activity_description: Design and implement a native JDBC source module to ingest data from relational databases using polling queries, supporting configurable datasources and row mappers.
Implement a Redis sink module leveraging Spring Data Redis to allow data ingestion into Redis structures (keys, lists, hashes, pub/sub channels).
Configure ZooKeeper client authentication and ACL permissions to restrict zNode access to authorized users and applications.
Refactor the core Trigger abstraction and registry to support custom user-defined trigger extensions and lifecycle management.
Develop a reference sample project demonstrating custom module creation and write comprehensive developer guidance documentation.
Implement a Kafka sink module supporting mass message publishing into Kafka topics with configurable serialization, partitioning, and producer settings.

activities.activity_name: Fix Grunt E2E Test Execution Issue
activities.activity_description: Investigate and fix the socket hangup error during 'grunt test:e2e' by refactoring server lifecycle execution within Grunt tasks.

activities.activity_name: Admin Server HTTPS Support & Spring Boot Upgrade
activities.activity_description: Update build configuration to pick up Spring Boot 1.1.7 SNAPSHOT and implement SSL/HTTPS configuration options for the Admin server REST API endpoints.
Perform end-to-end integration testing across all new modules (JDBC, Redis, Kafka), security features, and HTTPS endpoints.
